Finite complex-supplier circuit construction; **no new kappa**. Combining a restored target forest with disjoint helper shears on the **historical PR626 CK compensation** saves **75,318 real primitives per complete orientation**, including **8,798 beyond target forests alone**. The transformed matrix is repriced; predecessor savings are not added.

| Complete program | Original | Two-sided |
|---|---:|---:|
| Forward | 224,938 | 149,620 |
| Inverse transpose | 224,986 | 149,668 |

The 106 target edges and 112 helper pairs include every preparation/restoration gate, source access, coefficient operation and clear. Compensation drops from 8,704 to 2,541 additions. All non-scalar events and paid children remain unchanged. Prefix bounds are 41/65 bits within the inherited 192-bit local allowance; exact denominator budgets remain 3/8 bits.

### Reproduce

```sh
python3 -I -B research/complex-ck-two-sided/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_CK_TWO_SIDED`, `saved_real=75318`, `additional_vs_target=8798`, `columns=716+9`, `controls=10+25`, `no_new_kappa`.

Validation includes full literal primitive replay on **725 arbitrary input columns in both orientations**, using Fraction and separately implemented integer-dyadic arithmetic; independent Prim/census verification; unchanged native emitter/frame/wrapper audit with 25 inherited controls; 10 new corruption controls; 13 package tests; isolated normal/optimized execution; minimal relocation; recompression; source/recipe/typed-receipt corruption and output preservation. Selected-record integrity and its five tests pass. No cold supplier rebuild, full repository suite, global admission, Lean or hosted-CI pass is claimed.

Exact base: **f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631**. OS seed **38**, complex-supplier track. Complete search covers 12,544 target edges and 128,524 ordered helper-pair/sign cases, followed by one deterministic disjoint greedy pass; **no joint optimality claim**. Source hashes, historical SPEC binding, exact recipe, complete receipt, proof and local sprint claim are included. Only `research/complex-ck-two-sided/` is added. The final overlap check found 705 open PRs through #915 and no competing two-sided CK contribution; no pinned sprint issue was available.

Credit **David Awad #807** (`b1a5c533a22c2665600102d872f6a84e0664a70d`) for helper pairs and **@dd-hemant #816** (`133735a2cc2319c12ba5d786214b2217e083e7da`) for target forests, following **Sricharan Vagvala #749** and **Oscar Fennell #759**. No pending code is imported. Credit the unchanged **icekylinx / DreamingOfClouds / Jeremy Kothe #622 / Chafik Boukhalfa #626** construction and retained predecessor lineage.

The selected conditional result remains **PR799, kappa = 0.001661634653669567**. No transport to X4 is claimed. Production integration needs an admitted typed compensation rewrite, refreshed bindings and complete global invoices/assembly; all-size/compiler, realization, hosting, precision/tape and analytic obligations remain inherited. Finite evidence is not a full multiplication theorem proof.

Prepared by **Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, including separate AI arithmetic implementation and mathematical review. Apache-2.0; no independent human review claimed.
title: Finite construction: two-sided CK compensation saves 8,798 beyond target forests (no new kappa)
